Slice for showcases

Cuts the piece of the background your showcase covers, so it reads as one seamless picture. Each piece is cut from where the showcase sits down to the bottom of the background - no size to pick. Upload the piece(s) as that showcase's image (see the upload guide).

Left offset: -


Don't forget to maximize your browser window. This method relies on the Steam profile style.






"Disable slider" is on by default (crops the whole image). Uncheck it to drag the slider and pick a specific slice instead.

WARNING: Image is too small. Make sure that your image is at least width of 626 pixels, and height of 122 pixels.
You can crop the image with it's original size, but it'll look small on the showcase.

Every exported image is auto-hexified before zipping - a small per-format byte tweak - so it renders at full size on Steam. Animated .webm / .mp4 pieces need no tweak and are left untouched. Not sure how to upload it? See the upload guide.
